presets.name: Violin
presets.desc: Each picked note fades in from silence over a quarter second; stop each note before the next
presets.notes: Stopping each note lets the swell reset, so the next pick meets a closed gain: the attack is removed at zero latency

presets.name: Violin after the amp
presets.desc: The violin swell placed after the drive or amp, listening to the clean DI on the key input
presets.notes: Detection on the clean DI: a distorted signal has few transients left and lifts the hiss; needs the DI routed to the key bus

presets.name: Cello pad
presets.desc: Strummed chords swell in slowly as one bowed pad, one swell per strum; best into a long reverb
presets.notes: An 80 ms strum window merges slow strums into one swell; the S-curve lands softly

presets.name: Legato lead
presets.desc: Hammer-ons, pull-offs and slides swell too, not only picked notes; a slide swells once
presets.notes: The pitch-jump detector answers 8 – 16 ms after a legato note: a short blip, then the swell; lookahead 25 ms removes it in the studio

presets.name: Gentle bow changes
presets.desc: A new note only pulls the ringing one down a little before swelling: smooth bow changes
presets.notes: Dip 35 % keeps two thirds of the ringing note under the new one

presets.name: Reverse tape
presets.desc: Every note rises over a quarter note and stops dead: a backwards-tape feel locked to the tempo
presets.notes: Long rise, 40 ms decay: the attack-decay bow of the reverse-tape pedals

presets.name: Bowed stabs
presets.desc: Each note swells in fast and fades away by itself: a bowed attack and decay per note
presets.notes: With a decay the swell is spent after each bow; only a new pick, legato note or fire starts another

presets.name: Tempo swells
presets.desc: Swells that take a half note at the song's tempo, with a pedal-like taper; feed a dotted delay and a long reverb
presets.notes: The swell starts at the note, not on the grid; only its length follows the tempo

presets.name: Soft attack
presets.desc: Takes the edge off each pick: a 25 ms linear fade from half level, nothing else changes
presets.notes: Depth 50 % starts each note 6 dB down: a transient softener rather than a swell

presets.name: Foot swell
presets.desc: Swells only when the footswitch fires: re-swell a held chord on demand
presets.notes: Map Fire to a momentary footswitch; sens 0 and legato 0 leave the picks and legato detectors at their least eager

presets.name: Live clean retriggers
presets.desc: The violin swell with 3 ms of lookahead: re-picked notes lose their attack completely
presets.notes: 3 ms of reported latency hides every pick's dip; set at insert, never switched inside a song

presets.name: Studio perfect swell
presets.desc: The violin swell with 25 ms of lookahead: picked and legato notes all start at silence
presets.notes: For recording and re-amping: 25 ms of reported latency places the legato dips too, down to about 145 Hz

presets.name: Bowed bass
presets.desc: Bass notes fade in like a bowed double bass, at any playing level
presets.notes: Pitch jumps are read above 75 Hz only (from the D string's first frets up); below, legato swells through the flux detector or not at all

presets.name: Pads and keys
presets.desc: Removes the attack of keys and pads: each new chord swells in, even without a transient
presets.notes: The level gate opens after each silence; the flux detector catches a new chord over a ringing one
